title: UnionCity’s Three Towers Rise Near Unionville GO in Markham
summary:
Three towers are reshaping the skyline of Markham’s new southerly extension of Unionville at UnionCity. Designed by Arcadis for Metropia, the mixed-use condominium development will rise 36, 40, and 44 storeys from the north side of Enterprise Boulevard, within walking distance of Unionville GO station. UnionCity South is planned as the next phase, on the opposite side of Enterprise Boulevard.
